description: Comprehensive plant disease database for Indian agriculture — 30+ crops, 150+ diseases

rice.image_tips: Focus on leaf blade, leaf sheath, and panicle. Look for lesions, spots, and discoloration.

symptoms: Diamond-shaped lesions on leaves with gray centers and brown borders
Neck blast causes panicle breakage
Leaf spots may merge causing large blighted areas
Severe infection causes complete leaf drying
blast.favorable_conditions: High humidity (>90%), temperature 25-28°C, excessive nitrogen, standing water
chemical_treatment: Tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L — spray at booting stage
prevention: Use resistant varieties (e.g., Swarna Sub-1, IR-64)
Treat seeds with Trichoderma (4g/kg) or Carbendazim (2g/kg)
Avoid excess nitrogen — apply in splits

symptoms: Water-soaked streaks on leaf tips and margins
Lesions turn yellow to white, irregular shaped
Leaf wilting and drying from tips downward
Grains may become discolored and empty
bacterial_blight.favorable_conditions: Flooding, high temperature (28-34°C), wounds from insect damage
organic_treatment: Neem cake application (250 kg/ha) in soil
prevention: Use resistant varieties (Samba Mahsuri, Improved Pusa Basmati)
Remove and burn infected plant debris
Seed treatment with hot water (52°C for 30 min)

symptoms: Circular to oval brown spots with yellow halo
Spots coalesce causing leaf drying
Dark brown spots on grain reducing quality
Severe infection causes 'Karmin' disease — grain discoloration
brown_spot.favorable_conditions: Nutrient-poor soil, low nitrogen, high humidity
prevention: Ensure balanced nutrition — especially N, K, Si
Use healthy seeds from disease-free plants

symptoms: Oval or ellipsoidal lesions on leaf sheaths near waterline
Lesions have grayish-white center with brown margin
Disease progresses upward on the plant
Severe cases cause lodging and panicle blanking
sheath_blight.favorable_conditions: Dense planting, high nitrogen, standing water, 28-32°C
prevention: Avoid excess nitrogen and dense planting
Maintain proper water management — periodic draining

tungro.pathogen: Rice tungro bacilliform virus (RTBV) + Rice tungro spherical virus (RTSV)
symptoms: Yellow-orange discoloration of leaves
Stunted growth, reduced tillering
Grains may be discolored and chaffy
Plants appear bunched and short
tungro.favorable_conditions: Green leafhopper (Nephotettix virescens) vector, transplanting age
organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps for leafhopper monitoring
Neem oil spray (5ml/L) to repel vectors
Remove and destroy infected plants early

wheat.image_tips: Focus on leaf blades, check for rust pustules, brown lesions, and powdery growth.

symptoms: Yellow-orange linear streaks/pustules on leaves
Pustules arranged in rows along leaf veins
Leaves may turn completely yellow and dry
Early infection causes severe yield loss
yellow_rust.favorable_conditions: Cool temperature (10-15°C), high humidity, dew, cloudy weather
prevention: Monitor fields during cool, humid weather

symptoms: Brown, oval to circular raised pustules on leaves
Pustules rupture epidermis exposing brown spores
Leaves yellow and senesce prematurely
Rust pustules may also appear on leaf sheaths
brown_rust.favorable_conditions: Moderate temperature (15-22°C), high humidity, alternate host (barberry)

symptoms: 部分 grains replaced by black powdery mass (bunt balls)
Fishy odor from infected grains
Partially infected grains may look normal externally
Broken grains release dark brown to black spores
karnal_bunt.favorable_conditions: Cool temperature (15-22°C), high humidity at flowering, dew
prevention: Seed treatment with Carbendazim or Vitavax

symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on leaf surface
Leaves turn yellow and may curl upward
Stunting of infected plants
In severe cases, spikes may also be covered
powdery_mildew.favorable_conditions: Warm days (20-25°C), cool nights, high humidity, dry leaf surface
organic_treatment: Sulphur dust (10-15 kg/ha) at first sign
prevention: Proper plant spacing for air circulation

tomato.image_tips: Check leaves, stems, and fruits for spots, wilting, curling, and mold.

symptoms: Concentric ring pattern (target-like) on older leaves first
Dark brown to black lesions with yellow halo
Lesions may appear on stems near soil
Fruit lesions are dark, sunken, and may have fungal growth
early_blight.favorable_conditions: Warm (25-30°C), alternating wet/dry, low plant vigor

symptoms: Large, water-soaked, dark green to brown lesions
White fuzzy growth on leaf undersides in humid conditions
Rapid wilting of affected branches
Fruit shows firm, brown, rubbery rot
late_blight.favorable_conditions: Cool (15-22°C), very high humidity (>90%), foggy/dewy conditions
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
prevention: Ensure good air circulation — proper spacing
Spray preventively during cool, humid weather

symptoms: Sudden wilting of lower leaves during hot hours
Wilting may recover at night initially, then becomes permanent
Cut stem shows milky white bacterial ooze in water
Root system appears water-soaked and brown
bacterial_wilt.favorable_conditions: Warm (30-37°C), waterlogged or acidic soils, high moisture
prevention: Graft onto resistant rootstock (e.g., HP-1, Arka Kanchan)
Raise soil pH to 7.0+ with lime

leaf_curl_virus.pathogen: Tomato Leaf Curl Virus (ToLCV) — Whitefly transmitted
symptoms: Upward curling and cupping of leaves
Chlorosis (yellowing) of leaf margins
Stunted growth with small, thickened leaves
Flower drop and reduced fruit set
leaf_curl_virus.favorable_conditions: Whitefly (Bemisia tabaci) infestation, hot and dry conditions
organic_treatment: Yellow sticky traps for whitefly monitoring
Neem oil (5ml/L) spray for whitefly control
Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
prevention: Use insect-proof net house for nurseries
Control weeds that serve as virus reservoir

symptoms: Small, circular spots with dark borders and tan/gray centers
Tiny black dots (pycnidia) visible in spots
Lower leaves affected first, defoliation upward
Severe defoliation reduces fruit quality and yield

potato.image_tips: Check leaves for blight lesions, stems for blackleg, tubers for rot.

symptoms: Water-soaked, dark green to brown lesions on leaves
White fuzzy growth on leaf undersides
Black/brown lesions on stems
Tubers show reddish-brown dry rot under skin
prevention: Plant resistant varieties (Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Chipsona)

symptoms: Target-like concentric ring lesions on older leaves
Dark brown spots on tubers — corky dry rot
Premature defoliation
Reduced tuber size and yield
early_blight.favorable_conditions: Warm (25-30°C), alternating wet/dry, low plant vigor, nitrogen deficiency

symptoms: Black, slimy rot at stem base
Wilting of above-ground parts
Tubers show wet, creamy rot
Foul smell from rotting tissue
blackleg.favorable_conditions: Warm (25-30°C), wet soil, poor drainage, infected seed
prevention: Treat seed with fungicide before planting

symptoms: Rough, corky, raised lesions on tuber surface
Scab patches are tan to dark brown
Lesions may crack open
Cosmetic damage reducing market value
scab.favorable_conditions: Alkaline soil (pH >7.0), dry conditions at tuber formation
organic_treatment: Lower soil pH to 5.0-5.5 with elemental sulfur
Maintain adequate soil moisture during tuberization
chemical_treatment: Mancozeb 75% WP — foliar spray during tuberization

grape.image_tips: Check leaves for powdery white growth, berries for rot, shoots for cankers.

symptoms: Yellow, translucent oil spots on upper leaf surface
White cottony growth on leaf undersides
Shoots become stunted and distorted
Berries shrivel and dry up
downy_mildew.favorable_conditions: Warm (20-25°C), very high humidity, rain, dew
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) — spray before and after rain

symptoms: White powdery growth on leaves, shoots, and berries
Leaves may curl and distort
Berries crack and may develop secondary infections
Shoot growth is stunted and internodes shortened
powdery_mildew.favorable_conditions: Warm (25-30°C), high humidity but dry leaf surface, shade
organic_treatment: Sulfur dust (20-25 kg/ha) — apply when temp < 35°C
prevention: Proper canopy management — prune for air circulation
Timely sprays from bud break onward

symptoms: Small, circular, sunken spots on berries
Angular spots on leaves with brown centers
Shoot lesions cause dieback
Berries crack and may drop
prevention: Prune and train vines for good air circulation
Spray before rain during growing season

symptoms: Water-soaked angular lesions on leaves
Lesions turn brown and dry, falling out to give shot-hole effect
Shoot tips wilt and die back
Berries shrivel and dry
bacterial_blight.favorable_conditions: Warm, wet conditions, rain splash, wounds from pruning/hail

mango.image_tips: Check leaves for powdery coating, fruits for spots and rot, flowers for blight.

symptoms: White powdery coating on leaves, flowers, and young fruit
Leaves may curl and become distorted
Flower drop and poor fruit set
Fruit surface shows powdery patches — reduced market value
powdery_mildew.favorable_conditions: Warm days, cool nights, high humidity, poor air circulation

symptoms: Dark brown to black spots on leaves
Sunken, dark spots on fruit — may exude gum
Flower blight — flowers turn brown and drop
Fruit rot during ripening — large brown patches
anthracnose.favorable_conditions: Warm (25-30°C), humid, rainy conditions, post-harvest storage
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray at flowering and fruit development
prevention: Spray at flower initiation and fruit set
Harvest at proper maturity — avoid overripe
Hot water treatment (52°C for 5 min) for post-harvest

symptoms: Raised, corky, warty lesions on fruit
Angular water-soaked lesions on leaves
Cracks on stem bark
Premature fruit drop
bacterial_canker.favorable_conditions: Warm, wet conditions, rain splash, wounds
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plant parts

symptoms: Dieback of twigs and branches from tips
Dark brown to black lesions on branches
Gumming from affected areas
Fruit end rot — blackening from tip
dieback.favorable_conditions: Warm, humid conditions, drought stress, wound entry
organic_treatment: Apply paste of Trichoderma + cow dung on cut ends
Maintain tree vigor with balanced nutrition
chemical_treatment: Carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L — spray and paint cut ends
Metalaxyl + Mancozeb paint on cut wounds
prevention: Protect pruning cuts with fungicide paste

citrus.image_tips: Check leaves for canker lesions, fruit for spots, branches for dieback.

symptoms: Raised, corky, crater-like lesions on leaves
Lesions have oily, water-soaked margin
Similar lesions on fruit — reduce market value
Severe defoliation and fruit drop
canker.favorable_conditions: Warm, wet, windy conditions, rain splash, wounds
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected leaves and fruits

symptoms: Asymmetric yellowing of leaves (blotchy mottle)
Small, lopsided, bitter-tasting fruit
Vein yellowing and corky veins
Tree decline over 2-3 years
greening_huanglongbing.favorable_conditions: Asian citrus psyllid vector, warm climate
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected trees immediately

symptoms: Raised, corky, wart-like lesions on fruit
Small, raised spots on leaves
Distorted and curled young leaves
Cosmetic damage — fruit downgraded
scab.favorable_conditions: Warm, wet, humid conditions; young tissue susceptible

banana.image_tips: Check pseudostem for wilting, leaves for spots and yellowing, bunch for rot.

symptoms: Yellowing of older leaves from margins inward
Permanent wilting — leaves hang down like a skirt
Vascular discoloration (red-brown) in pseudostem
Complete plant death within weeks
panama_wilt.favorable_conditions: Warm (27-30°C), acidic, well-drained soil, contaminated soil
organic_treatment: There is NO cure once plant is infected
Remove and destroy infected plants (do not compost)
Add Trichoderma to soil as preventive
chemical_treatment: Carbendazim soil drench may slow spread
prevention: Do NOT replant banana in infected soil

symptoms: Dark brown to black streaks on leaf veins
Spots expand into large necrotic areas
Premature leaf drying — reduces photosynthesis
Severe defoliation affects bunch filling

bunchy_top.pathogen: Banana bunchy top virus (BBTV) — aphid transmitted
symptoms: Narrow, upright, bunched leaves at top
Leaves have chlorotic margins and dark green streaks
Stunted growth — no bunch formation
Plants eventually stop producing fruit
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
prevention: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately

chilli.image_tips: Check leaves for leaf curl, fruits for rot and spots, stems for wilting.

leaf_curl.pathogen: Chilli leaf curl virus (ChiLCV) — Whitefly transmitted
symptoms: Upward curling and cupping of leaves
Thickened, leathery leaves
Reduced leaf size — bushy appearance
Severe stunting and reduced fruiting
Dark, sunken lesions on chilli fruits
Fruit drying on plant — stem-end rot
Dark cankers on stems causing dieback
Infected fruits hang on plant, dry and shriveled
Water-soaked lesions on stems at soil line
Fruit shows soft, watery rot — white moldy growth
Sudden wilting and death of whole plant
Root rot — brown, water-soaked roots
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately

cotton.image_tips: Check leaves for spots, bolls for rot, stems for wilting.

symptoms: Soft rot of bolls — bolls turn brown and burst
Fungal growth on boll surface
Premature boll opening and fiber staining
Reduced lint quality and yield
boll_rot.favorable_conditions: High humidity, rain, warm temperature, dense canopy
organic_treatment: Maintain plant vigor with balanced nutrition

symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of lower leaves first
Vascular browning in stem cross-section
Progressive wilting leading to plant death
Internal stem discoloration — reddish brown

soybean.image_tips: Check leaves for fungal growth, pods for spots, stems for wilting.

symptoms: Small, tan to reddish-brown raised pustules on leaves
Pustules mostly on lower leaf surface
Premature defoliation
Reduced seed size and oil content
rust.favorable_conditions: Warm (22-28°C), high humidity, prolonged leaf wetness
organic_treatment: Early sowing to escape peak rust period

symptoms: Mosaic pattern — light and dark green mottling on leaves
Leaf distortion and rugosity
Stunting of infected plants
Reduced seed set and pod filling

groundnut.image_tips: Check leaves for rust pustules, pegs and pods for rot, roots for nodulation.

symptoms: Small, circular, reddish-brown raised pustules on lower leaf surface
Yellow halo around pustules
Premature defoliation
Reduced pod filling and yield
Circular, dark brown spots on upper leaf surface
Spots have light brown to gray centers
Yellow halo around spots
Premature leaf drop in severe cases

sugarcane.image_tips: Check leaves for red rot lesion, stalks for internal rot, leaves for smut.

symptoms: Reddish discoloration of internal stalk tissue
White patches within red area (internally)
Dried top with withered leaves
Bitter taste of juice — reduced sugar recovery
red_rot.favorable_conditions: Warm (25-30°C), wet conditions, wounds from borers/crushing
organic_treatment: Treat setts with Trichoderma (10g/L) — soak 30 min
prevention: Control borers that create entry wounds

symptoms: Black, whip-like structure emerging from shoot apex
The black whip (sorus) is covered with black spore powder
Affected shoots become stunted
Shoots may produce secondary whips
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy whips before they open
Treat setts with hot water (52°C for 30 min)

cucumber.image_tips: Check leaves for downy mildew, fruits for rot and spots.

symptoms: Angular, yellow patches on upper leaf surface
Purple-gray fuzzy growth on leaf undersides
Leaves eventually turn brown and crispy
Severe defoliation reduces fruit yield
downy_mildew.favorable_conditions: Cool to warm (15-22°C), high humidity, rain/dew

brinjal.image_tips: Check leaves for spots and wilting, fruits for borer damage and rot.

symptoms: Severely reduced leaf size — tiny, narrow leaves
Leaves become yellow-green and upright
Profuse branching giving witches' broom appearance
No fruit formation — plant becomes sterile
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately

symptoms: Circular, sunken, brown lesions on fruit
Concentric rings visible in older lesions
Small brown spots on leaves with yellow halo
Fruit rot leads to total loss

onion.image_tips: Check leaves for purple blotch, neck for rot, bulbs for basal rot.

symptoms: Purple, elongated, sunken lesions on leaves
Concentric rings visible in lesions
Tips of leaves turn yellow and die back
Neck rot in stored bulbs
prevention: Proper curing of bulbs before storage

symptoms: Pale green to yellow patches on leaves
Violet-gray fuzzy growth on leaf tips in humid weather
Leaves become soft and collapse
Flower stalks become bent and distorted
prevention: Spray preventively during cool, humid weather

okra.image_tips: Check leaves for mosaic, pods for yellow vein mosaic virus.

yellow_mosaic_virus.pathogen: Okra yellow mosaic virus — Whitefly transmitted
symptoms: Bright yellow mosaic patches on leaves
Leaf distortion and stunting
Fruits may be distorted and small
Severe infection causes complete yellowing
prevention: Use resistant varieties (Pusa A-4, Arka Anamika)

watermelon.image_tips: Check leaves for wilt and mildew, fruits for rot and cracking.

symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of one side of vine
Vascular browning in stem
Progressive wilting leading to plant death
Root system may be brown and decayed

pomegranate.image_tips: Check fruits for bacterial blight spots, leaves for wilting.

symptoms: Small, water-soaked spots on leaves — turn brown
Circular, brown, sunken lesions on fruit
Fruit cracking and oozing
Twig dieback and canker
bacterial_blight.favorable_conditions: Warm, wet, rainy conditions; rain splash; wounds
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plant parts

papaya.image_tips: Check fruits for ringspot virus spots, leaves for yellowing, trunk for wilting.

symptoms: Chlorotic (yellow) mosaic and ring spots on fruits
Leaf mosaic pattern — light and dark green mottling
Stunted growth and reduced fruit size
Leaf distortion — narrow, shoestring-like leaves
ring_spot_virus.favorable_conditions: Aphid vector, warm conditions, proximity to infected plants
organic_treatment: Remove and destroy infected plants immediately
Use reflective mulch to repel aphids
prevention: Plant papaya away from infected areas

coconut.image_tips: Check leaves for yellowing, inflorescence for beetle damage, nuts for rot.

symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of younger leaves
Inflorescence rot — button stage fruits drop
Splitting of nuts
Complete yellowing and death in 3-6 months
organic_treatment: Bordeaux mixture (1%) — soil drench around base

pea.image_tips: Check leaves for powdery white growth, pods for spots.

symptoms: White powdery growth on upper leaf surface
Leaves turn yellow and may curl
Stunting and reduced pod formation
Premature leaf drop
powdery_mildew.favorable_conditions: Warm (20-25°C), high humidity, dry leaf surface

pigeon_pea.image_tips: Check leaves for wilt, pods for borers, branches for dieback.

symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of branches
Vascular browning in stem cross-section
Progressive branch dieback
Complete plant death

mustard.image_tips: Check leaves for Alternaria spots, flowers for white rust.

symptoms: Circular, brown spots with concentric rings on leaves
Spots coalesce causing large blighted areas
Pod infection causing shattering
Premature leaf drop and pod abortion
prevention: Timely sowing — early sowing escapes peak disease

symptoms: White, blister-like pustules on lower leaf surface
Upper surface shows yellow-green patches
Stem and flower stalk distortion
Pod malformation — 'shepherd's crook' appearance
white_rust.favorable_conditions: Cool (15-20°C), high humidity, prolonged leaf wetness

sunflower.image_tips: Check head for Alternaria, leaves for mildew and rust.

symptoms: Dark brown to black spots on capitulum (head)
Spots may cover entire head — rot of seeds
Concentric rings visible in lesions
Leaf spots with yellow halo
